name: dotmatrix-loaders
title: Dotmatrix Loaders
description: A collection of nineteen small loading indicators, each a grid of glowing dots arranged as a square, circle, triangle, hexagon or 3x3 block. They animate with sweeps, ripples, spirals and gradient blooms.
use: A product wants a set of coordinated loading indicators that share a dot-matrix look across several colours.
avoid: Each loader is tiny and decorative, so it needs a label for meaning, and importing all nineteen adds weight.
a11y: Each loader takes an ariaLabel, but there is no status role or live region to announce loading, and reduced motion holds a still pattern. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark grid of small rounded-square cards, each holding a tiny matrix of dots and a short uppercase caption underneath. Dots glow in white, blue, mint, red, orange and purple, some with a soft bloom; the last cell instead shows a big 19 above the word loaders.
behaves: Each loader runs its own loop: dots brighten in sweeps, ripples, spirals, comets or glyph morphs, with the lit pattern shifting every second or so. Some cycles use gradient colours and a glow; the set holds a still pattern when reduced motion is requested.
customise: Size, dot size, colour or colour preset, speed, pattern, dot shape, bloom, halo and animated/hoverAnimated are shared props; the per-loader motion is fixed in each file.
weight: light: Many tiny dot grids, but only opacity and colour change; idle when reduced motion is on.
demo: Uppercase labels like Diagonal sweep, Square 02, Circular 09, Triangle 08, Hex 04 and 3x3 14, plus a 19 loaders cell.
issues: Triangle 08's dots are almost invisible against its dark tile.
Some loaders are so small and dim that the dot pattern is hard to read.
polishWhy: Charming coordinated set with varied motion and colour; several tiles are too dim to read.
